title: Gothic Valentine SVG Bundle, Anatomical Heart, Bat Heart, Thorn Heart, Padlock, Skeleton Key Cut Files, Cricut, Silhouette (svg, dxf, png)
description:
Six original gothic Valentine heart cut files for anyone who prefers their love a little dark: an anatomical-style heart with vessels and groove lines, a bat heart with spread wings, a thorned rose-vine heart wreath, a heart padlock with a pointed gothic shackle and keyhole, a skeleton key with a heart bow, and a gothic arch window with a heart cut out. Bold, simple shapes read clearly even when small.

Each design is a single-layer, single-path cut file with every part joined, so nothing falls out. Use them for Valentine cards, decals, wall art, tumblers, laser-cut wood or acrylic, and more.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
• 6 designs: Anatomical Heart, Bat Heart, Thorned Rose Heart Wreath, Gothic Heart Padlock, Skeleton Key with Heart Bow, Gothic Arch Window with Heart
• SVG: Cricut Design Space, Silhouette Designer Edition, Inkscape, Illustrator
• DXF: Silhouette Studio Basic Edition, laser software (inches)
• PNG: transparent background, 1800 px on the longest side (6 in at 300 DPI)

SIZE
Default size is about 6 in on the longest side. Fine tips and slits are about 0.08 in wide or more at 6 in; we recommend 5 in or larger for cardstock and vinyl and 6 in for laser-cut wood or acrylic.

LICENSE
Personal use, plus small-business use on up to 500 finished physical items per design. Please don't share or resell the digital files.

THIS IS A DIGITAL DOWNLOAD
No physical item will be shipped. Files are available right after purchase in a single ZIP.

Listing photos include digital mockups; you receive the digital files shown.

Designed with the help of digital and AI tools, and checked by hand for clean cuts.
